# P02 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 2914ff484cea963e

The room settles what its mark will show of it: a member proposes a picture, the room argues its design, makes its land's flag or emblems the mark, signs it or leaves it unsigned, claims a mark others made, adds to it or enlarges it, or adds a personal piece to a shared mark.

tier ['T4-006']; dimension ['D02']; status standing; since C2-pass-1
